blocks.text: [ K-IG 교육- principle07]
Principle 7: At the Academy
After school, most of my friends and I go to academies.
There are many academies that teach different subjects.
I go to a piano academy, English academy,
and art academy near my home.
Some of my other friends go to more academies than I do,
so they are very busy every day.
They have very little time to play with me during the week.
My favorite academy is English.
Everyday I go and learn new sentences, words, and songs.
I love role-playing and speaking English with my friends.
I want to learn to speak English fluently in the future
because I know that English will be helpful in my future job.
There are about ten students in my class at the English academy.
I have a wide variety of friends.
Some of my friends are really good at memorizing words and phrases.
Some of my other friends are really good at conversational English.
There are a few of my friends who are shy and don’t like to speak out loud,
but they have really good pronunciation because they speak very carefully.
My English academy teacher is Korean.
Even though he is from Korea,
he has studied English for many years and knows it very well.
When he speaks, he sounds like a native English speaker.
He learned English while studying abroad.
He teaches us very well, and his class activities are always fun.
I want to be able to speak English as well as he does someday.
